description: This file implements a class MetricsLogObserver that logs different types of MetricsFrame data, including TTFB, processing time, LLM token usage, TTS usage, and smart turn metrics, to the console using loguru. It is designed to monitor and debug metrics in the Pipecat pipeline.

classes.name: MetricsLogObserver
classes.description: A subclass of BaseObserver that logs various metrics data from MetricsFrame instances to the console, with filtering options based on included metrics types.

methods.name: __init__( self, include_metrics: Optional[Set[Type[MetricsData]]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the MetricsLogObserver with optional filtering for specific metrics.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Handles incoming frame data, logs metrics frames that are new and match filter criteria.

methods.name: bool _should_log_metrics(self, metrics_data: MetricsData)
methods.description: Determines whether a given metrics data should be logged based on included metrics filter.

methods.name: _log_metrics_data(self, metrics_data: MetricsData, time_sec: float)
methods.description: Logs individual metrics data based on its type, formatting the message accordingly.

methods.name: _log_llm_usage( self, metrics_data: LLMUsageMetricsData, processor_info: str, model_info: str, time_sec: float, )
methods.description: Logs detailed token usage for LLM metrics.

methods.name: _log_smart_turn( self, metrics_data: SmartTurnMetricsData, processor_info: str, model_info: str, time_sec: float, )
methods.description: Logs detailed metrics related to smart turn prediction.
